content.text:
I fixed the regression in `api/errors.go`. The refactor had changed `CodeConflict` from `http.StatusConflict` (409) to `http.StatusBadRequest` (400) in the new `statusByCode` table. Duplicate-SKU errors on item creation therefore came back as 400 instead of 409.

I changed that one table entry back to 409. The `statusByCode` table and the `respondError` helper are unchanged, and I didn't commit or touch any test files. `go test ./...` passes.

The other changes in the working tree are the `writeError` to `respondError` rename and two comment edits, in `report/report.go` and `util/strings.go`. None of them change behavior.
